connector.name: MCP by lemmaoracle
connector.registryDescription: Verifiable provenance for AI agents - ZK proofs over confidential documents, no plaintext exposure.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.lemma.workers.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lemmaoracle account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization

env.name: LEMMA_API_BASE
env.description: Optional API base URL. Defaults to production endpoint.
